recent_posts.title: Claude Code Tutorial Dropped #claude #claudecode
recent_posts.summary: A course announcement for a Claude Code tutorial that walks through building and deploying a full-stack AI-powered support ticket system. The project includes authentication, role-based access control, ticket management, AI-powered summarization, reply polishing, and an autonomous email-handling AI agent. The course emphasizes real engineering practices including code review, refactoring, and automated tests — not just vibe coding. The instructor claims to have built the app in roughly two working days using Claude Code, compared to an estimated 2–3 weeks manually.

recent_posts.title: Build a full stack app with Claude Code from scratch
recent_posts.summary: A comprehensive tutorial course on using Claude Code (Anthropic's agentic coding tool) to build and deploy a full-stack AI-powered support ticket system. Covers Claude Code fundamentals including installation, prompting strategies, plan mode, context window management, MCP tools, and cost tracking. The course builds a real production app with React frontend, Express backend, authentication, role-based access control, AI-powered features (ticket summarization, reply polishing, auto-classification), email integration, and CI/CD deployment. Emphasizes engineering fundamentals alongside AI tooling — reviewing every line of generated code, refactoring, and writing automated tests.

recent_posts.title: Programming languages to learn in 2026 for junior developers
recent_posts.summary: The job market for junior developers is recovering, with entry-level positions increasing 47% since October 2023. While AI is changing expectations, companies are still hiring but now expect faster productivity and stronger fundamentals. The US has around 24,000 open entry-level positions, and Europe faces a significant tech talent shortage requiring nearly 10 million workers by 2030. Success requires understanding multiple languages, frameworks, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively with AI tools.

recent_posts.title: Understanding Microsoft's recent layoffs and the broader tech industry trends
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft's recent layoffs of 6,000 employees are part of a broader trend of corporate restructuring, unrelated to AI. Historical industry layoffs, like those of HP and Intel, demonstrate strategic pivots towards new growth areas, such as cloud computing. The tech industry continues to evolve, requiring engineers with deep foundational skills rather than reliance on AI tools alone. The focus should remain on adaptability and continuous learning to stay relevant in the industry.
